collection.title: Citroen DS3 Cabriolet 2012 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a 2012 - 2016 Citroen DS3 Cabriolet model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
